name: Beef roll
desc: Thin rolled beef slices that cook in the broth, juicy and savoury.

name: Pork
desc: Juicy pork adds richness, making every spoonful extra satisfying.

name: Meatballs
desc: Springy meatballs that soak up the broth as they cook.

name: Fishcake
desc: Bouncy fishcake adds savoury chew, cute shapes and instant joy.

name: Crab sticks
desc: Soften in the bowl, adding a mild, sweet seafood flavour.

name: Tofu
desc: Savoury tofu offers plant-based protein with a hearty texture.

name: Spring onion
desc: Bright aroma, mild bite and that fresh finishing touch.

name: Onion
desc: Aromatic onion releases sweetness, adding depth to the broth.

name: Mushrooms
desc: Fresh mushrooms bring juicy bites and natural umami.

name: Shiitake
desc: Smoky umami, tender caps and bold fragrance.

name: Enoki
desc: Delicate, slurpable mushroom strands that soak up the soup.

name: Corn
desc: Sweet corn bursts with every bite and adds a pleasant crunch.

name: Lettuce
desc: Crisp lettuce softens fast, adding freshness and light crunch.

name: Cabbage
desc: Stays crunchy, adding volume and gentle sweetness.

name: Seaweed
desc: Umami seaweed melts in the heat, boosting ocean flavour and aroma.

name: Extra noodles
desc: Extra hungry? Add another block of springy noodles.

name: Egg
desc: Crack it on top of the noodles in the last 30 seconds. On the noodles, not the bowl, so it doesn't burn.

name: Cheese
desc: Lay it on top of the noodles in the last 30 seconds and let it melt into the broth.

name: Chicken wings
desc: Chicken wings on the side, ready to eat.

name: Fried Spam
desc: Salty, savoury fried Spam slices, the classic Korean army-stew upgrade.

name: Shrimp katsu
desc: Crispy shrimp katsu crunches loud, with a sweet seafood snap inside.

name: Tempura prawn
desc: A crunchy battered prawn to eat on the side or lay on top at the end.

name: Soft-boiled egg
desc: Already cooked, with a soft jammy yolk. Halve it over your bowl.

name: Seasoned seaweed
desc: Crispy seasoned seaweed sheets, plain or green tea, to crumble over or snack on.
